semantic.justification: Original GetSystemDateTime date-output branch. The browser host supplies system_clock/localtime through numeric Date construction and local field getters; text date parsing and calendar arithmetic are not delegated to it. Native nanosecond time output is not exposed by this binding. Only the original date-output branch is exposed. The browser host supplies numeric system-clock/local-date fields; nanosecond clock output and native platform failure/ABI behavior remain unverified. Text parsing and calendar arithmetic are not delegated to the host.
